composed_text.description: Composed reminder body, SMS-friendly (<=280 chars). Empty string on the on_failure defensive default.

suggested_channel.description: Skill's suggested delivery channel; the pipeline's _resolve_delivery_channel treats this as a hint and may override based on per-member overrides.

validation_failed.description: Skill-side flag (true on the on_failure defensive-default path); the pipeline-side emit guard sets the canonical value on the emitted reminder.dispatched event.

reasons.description: Reasons array; on_failure populates with skill_failure_defensive_default.
